description.zh:
数据库名称。命名规则如下：
- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、中划线（-）组成。
- 以小写字母开头，且以小写字母或数字结尾。
- 长度最多为64个字符。

><notice>下划线（_）会被看作两个字符。></notice>
description.en:
The name of the database. The name must meet the following requirements:

- Consist of lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- Start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

- Be up to 64 characters in length.

><notice>

An underscore (\_) is counted as two characters.

></notice>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun clickhouse create-db --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-bp100p4q1g9z30000 --db-name testdb001 --comment test --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun clickhouse CreateDB --region cn-hangzhou --Comment test --DBInstanceId 'cc-bp100p4q1g9z30000' --DBName testdb001 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
